statement: Pinned Linux hid-playstation expects DualSense full input 0x01/64 bytes on USB and 0x31/78 bytes on Bluetooth; BT has different header placement and CRC validation, and the common parsed report has six analog controls, button groups, IMU, timestamp, two touch contacts and status bytes.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, HHD adbd50f, virtualgamepad archive a5310c6; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 81-95, 244-267, 1448-1477; source-only consumer framing, not a retail capture.
